info.title: Ekoz server API
info.description: HTTP API of the Ekoz reference server, consumed by `@ekozhq/sdk`. Errors use `application/problem+json` (RFC 9457).

type.description: URI reference identifying the problem type. `about:blank` when unspecified.

status.description: HTTP status code, repeated in the body per RFC 9457.

detail.description: Human-readable explanation specific to this occurrence.

code.description: Stable machine-readable error code, namespaced by domain.

errors.description: Per-field validation issues, present only for `validation_failed`.

path.description: Dotted path to the offending field, e.g. `body.email`.

requestId.description: Correlation id, echoed from / generated for the request.

ProblemDetailsDto.description: RFC 9457 `application/problem+json` body — the single error shape for the REST surface.
